comments.text:
Migrate the web app's useMixer hook to consume parameter metadata from the ParamRegistry via WASM.

DEPENDS ON: i7-49c.1 (ParamRegistry)

CURRENT STATE: web/src/useMixer.ts has hardcoded parameter details scattered across ~30 setter callbacks. web/src/ChannelStrip.tsx and synth-ui components hardcode min/max/default/label for each knob.

CHANGES:
1. Expose ParamRegistry via WASM: add a function like mixerParamsJson() that returns the registry as JSON
2. In the web app, create a useParamRegistry() hook that loads the registry once and provides lookup by param ID
3. Update useMixer setter callbacks to reference registry entries instead of hardcoding
4. This is a refactor — no behavioral changes, just centralizing metadata

REFERENCE:
- crates/integral-core/src/param_registry.rs (from i7-49c.1)
- web/src/useMixer.ts: current hardcoded setters
- web/src/types.ts: PartState default values

title: Web: migrate useMixer to consume ParamRegistry from WASM
